id: \bThe bookcase could be a secret entrance.
en: \bThe bookcase could be a secret entrance.
it: \bLa libreria potrebbe essere un passaggio segreto.
\bDeve esserci un interruttore da qualche parte.

id: \bYou want a fossil revived? Kid, this is a museum. Go bother someone else.
en: \bYou want a fossil revived? Kid, this is a museum.  Go bother someone else.
it: \bVuoi far rianimare un fossile? Ragazzino, questo è un museo.  Va' a scocciare qualcun altro.

id: \bHawes: Welcome to the museum. I'm Lenora's husband and help run the gym.
en: \bHawes: Welcome to the museum. I'm Lenora's husband and help run the gym.
it: \bHawes: Benvenuto al museo. Sono il marito di Aloé e la aiuto a gestire la Palestra.

id: \bHawes: My wife wanted you to see me. She must want me to give you these.
en: \bHawes: My wife wanted you to see me. She must want me to give you these.
it: \bHawes: Mia moglie voleva che venissi da me. Deve volere che ti dia questi.

id: \bLenora uses Normal type Pokémon. They are weak against only the Fighting type.
en: \bLenora uses Normal type Pokémon. They are weak against only the Fighting type.
it: \bAloé usa Pokémon di tipo Normale. Sono deboli solo contro il tipo Lotta.

id: \bThey are strong against nothing. They are immune to Ghost type moves as well.
en: \bThey are strong against nothing. They are immune to Ghost type moves as well.
it: \bNon sono superefficaci contro nessun tipo. In più, sono immuni alle mosse di tipo Spettro.

id: \rOne of the bookcases moves. Which one is it?
en: \rOne of the bookcases moves. Which one is it?
it: \rUna delle librerie si sposta. Quale sarà?

id: \bWhat? I'm not a Trainer. I'm just looking for a book.
en: \bWhat? I'm not a Trainer. I'm just looking for a book.
it: \bCosa? Non sono un Allenatore. Sto solo cercando un libro.
